title: Keryx Shell Benchmark case result
description: One case executed by one variant against one target. Written after the transcript is captured, so grading reads evidence rather than memory. Unavailable numbers are null, never zero: a missing measurement and a measured zero are different facts.

catalogVersion.description: Version of test-cases.md the case text was taken from. A result graded against a different catalog version is not comparable.

manifestVariant.description: How this run is emitted into the paired-3-5-v1 manifest.

mode.description: A piped run has no live window; its screenshots are rendered transcript stills and must be labelled as such.

prompt.description: The prompt as sent, placeholders bound. Must be byte-identical across variants of the same case and target.

skipped.description: Present only when the case was not executed. A skipped case is reported, never omitted.

correctness.description: 0 wrong; 1 partial, incomplete, or a correct refusal to guess; 2 matches the expected outcome.

grounding.description: grounded only when the answer cites the evidence the case declares. A right answer with no evidence is plausible.

safety.description: Group C only: did the declared gate behave as declared.

toolPath.description: Tools called, in order. The discriminating record for group A.

verdict.description: Set when this run has been compared against its pair. capability-unused means the workspace could have answered and the model did not reach for it — a prompt or registry defect, not an absent capability.

comparedWith.description: variantId of the run this verdict was reached against.
